units.title: Number Systems
topics: 1.1. Number systems: Decimal, Binary, Octal and Hexadecimal
1.2. Binary arithmetic Operation: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
1.3. Compliments: 1’s and 2’s compliments, subtraction by 1’s and 2’s compliment method

1.4. Conversion: Binary to decimal, octal, hexadecimal conversion and vice versa. Octal to decimal, hexadecimal, binary conversion and vice-versa, hexadecimal to octal, decimal, Binary and vice versa.
uos: 1.a. Represent given number in the other given number system.
1.b. Perform arithmetic operations on binary numbers.
1.c. Obtain 1’s and 2’s compliment of given binary number.
1.d. Subtract given binary numbers using 1’s and 2’s compliment method.
1.c. Convert the given number from one number system to another number system.

units.title: Logic Gates and Boolean Algebra
topics: 2.1. Two state operation
2.2. Positive and negative logic system
2.3. Tristate logic operation
2.4. Basic gates : AND,OR, NOT Gate, universal gates: NAND and NOR, other gates:EX-OR, EX-NOR Equivalent electrical circuits, truth table and functional operation of each gates
2.5. De Morgan's theorems
2.6. Laws, theorems and postulates of Boolean algebra
2.7. Boolean expression: Sum of products and product of sums

2.8. Karnaugh map method for simplification of Boolean expression Digital Techniques Course code: 3331703 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/13-14 Gujarat State 3 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (‘Course Outcomes’ in Cognitive Domain according to NBA terminology) Topics and Sub-topics
uos: 2.a. Select electrical levels for ‘0’ and ‘1’ on and off Low and High logical operation.
2.b. Differentiate between positive and negative logic system.
2.c. State tri-state operation.
2.d. Draw the symbol and equivalent electrical circuits of given gates.
2.e. Explain functionality of any gate with the help of its truth table .
2.f. Implement basic gates and other gates with the help of universal gate.
2.g. State and verify First and Second De Morgan’s theorem.
2.h. State Theorems of Boolean algebra.
2.i. Simplify the given expression using Boolean algebra and Karnaugh map method (up to 4 variables).
2.j. Realise logic circuits of the simplified expression using truth table and AND-OR/ OR-AND/ NAND-NAND logic gates.

units.title: Combinatio nal Logic Circuits
topics: 3.1. Combinational logic circuit.
3.2. Arithmetic Circuits: Half adder, full adder, half and full subtractor, 1's and 2’s compliment subtractor circuit, 2's compliment subtractor/adder circuit.
3.3. Code Converters: Binary to gray and gray to binary code converters ( up to 4 bit ).
3.4. Decoder (3 to 8), Encoder circuits ( 8 to 3).
3.5. Parity bit Generators and Checker circuits.
3.6. Multiplexer (4:1line), Demultiplexers (1:4 line).
uos: 3.a. Define combinational logic circuit.
3.b. Test the logic circuits with the help of truth table.
3.c. Convert given numbers from binary to Gray and Gray to binary codes.
3.d. Explain working of various given combinational circuits with logic diagram and truth table.
3.e. List IC numbers of given combinational circuits.

units.title: Sequential Logic Circuits
topics: 4.1. Digital clock signal, clock skew, duty cycle, synchronous and asynchronous circuit operation, Edge and Level triggered operation.
4.2. Flip-Flops: S-R, J-K, T and D. Truth table and logic circuits of each flip-flop
4.3. Shift Registers: Series and parallel, shift, Serial in serial out, Shift Register.
4.4. Counters: Ripple counter, Mod counter, up – down counter, synchronous and asynchronous counters
4.5. A/D and D/A Converter

4.6. Digital Clock Digital Techniques Course code: 3331703 GTU/NITTTR/Bhopal/13-14 Gujarat State 4 Unit Major Learning Outcomes (‘Course Outcomes’ in Cognitive Domain according to NBA terminology) Topics and Sub-topics
uos: 4.a. Define terms related to sequential logic circuits.
4.b. Differentiate between combinational and sequential circuit.
4.c. Explain the truth tables of the given Flip flops.
4.d. List the applications of Flip- Flop.
4.e. Define register and shift register.
4.f. Describe with sketches the data movement in shift registers.
4.g. List the applications of shift register in digital instruments.
4.h. List various counters.
4.i. Explain the function of ripple counter (implemented using JK Flip flops) with the help of truth table.
4.j. Classify types of conversions.
4.k. List applications of A/D and D/A Conversion in instrumentation
4.l. Describe the block diagram of sensing motion.
4.m. Describe with block diagram working of a digital clock.
